name: bookmarks-mirror
description: Firefox extension: one-way mirror of a bookmarks YAML file into the browser.

scripts.build: esbuild src/background.js src/options.js --bundle --format=iife --target=firefox140 --outdir=dist && cp src/manifest.json src/options.html src/icon.svg dist/
scripts.lint: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --overwrite-dest
scripts.sign: npm run build && web-ext sign --source-dir dist --channel=listed --amo-metadata amo-metadata.json --upload-source-code web-ext-artifacts/source.zip --approval-timeout=0
